integrity: The main result is an exact probability inequality. The DAPW counterexample is recomputed from the published PMF/CDF and Scenario 4 parameters, and the standalone checker is used only for replay and arithmetic verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem controls only truncation of the stress–strength probability series at fixed parameter values.
The counterexample addresses the stopping rule as printed and does not infer unpublished implementation details.
The simple survival upper bound is rigorous but may not be the tightest model-specific remainder estimate.
title: Certified truncation bounds for discrete stress–strength reliability expose a DAPW stopping-rule gap
